members.name: Sydney Yapoujian
members.bio: Board Chairperson since 2019, based in Boulder, Colorado. Brings experience in business management and corporate leadership to the organisation’s planning, decision-making and governance.

members.name: Lily Ribeiro
members.bio: USA Director and Board Secretary & Treasurer, serving since 2018 from Colorado. An experienced pilot who has led trauma-healing workshops for communities affected by conflict and displacement.

members.name: Rev. John Kerim
members.bio: Theologian and organisational leader with over 12 years’ experience. Executive Director since 2018; formerly Country Program Manager, Wycliffe Associates (USA).
